name: Maj'hel
source:
"Also known as Maggie, the estate agent and Doctor Marie. She had to keep her true identity hidden not to be discovered along with the ones she was protecting. Maj'hel is a brilliant scientist and specialize in genetics, biochemistry and has been known to dabble with physics.
She's hypersexual like most women on her world. She's extremely driven and her 'children' are her life. She will do anything to keep them safe."

[In-game description]
